title: Checkpoint: does each element beat the suffix?
prompt:
Count positions i where `arr[i]` is **strictly greater than the sum of all elements after i**. Implement `process(int[] arr)` (0 for empty).

Example: `{3, 1, 2}` → positions: 3>3? no; 1>2? no; 2>0 (nothing after)? yes → `1`.

tests.name: dominant positions
tests.hint: Walk from the right keeping a running suffix sum; count when arr[i] > suffixSoFar.
